capabilities: rename the most recent open note's pending marker to a done marker
create a new date-stamped note in the same folder
carry over the previous note's content or fill from a template file with token substitution
mark only the active note as done via a second command
configure folder, date format, label, and markers per naming convention
extras: Warns that markers and labels become part of file names, so characters Obsidian disallows in titles must be avoided; commands have no default hotkey and must be assigned manually.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in one-command way to mark a dated note as finished and open the next date-stamped note with consistent naming.
summary: Date-stamped note workflow plugin that closes the previous dated note (renaming its pending marker to done) and creates the next one, optionally from a template.
